<!-- pr-reviewer: bc17b22b15a0ae8b1a5f9a037274938fbccb7b8e -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

What looks good
- With zero extension, `slot_extended_ends` returns `(a, b)` unchanged. The generator `slot()` is not changed. The project file writes the new keys only when they are not zero. The parameter digest appends them only when one is not zero. No golden and no snapshot changed. `golden_cl`, `recorded_post_streams` and `project_roundtrip` pass.
- The machine area is the stadium of the extended ends (`material_source.rs:218`). The part law (`depth_law_of`, `authored_law`) does not read A or B. An extension into a kept part is therefore a blocking Gouge, on a part source and on a stock source. The tests prove that `post_setup` refuses and writes no file.
- Bad values are refused at command creation (`sane.rs`, `nneg`) and again in the generator (`slot_ends.rs`). The command is undoable. `edit_operation` reaches the fields through the Slot DTO. The decision record is present.

Results, merged with main, run locally (no runner used)
- `slot_extension` 5 passed, `slot_caps` 4, `slot_picks` 8, `slot_pick_refusals` 3, `golden_cl` 33, `project_roundtrip` 73, `recorded_post_streams` 5, `operations` 119 (6 ignored), `mcp` 22, `stock_source_law` 7, `kept_parts_live` 4, `refusal_ghost` 4, motion `slot_ends` 3. All pass.
- `camcraft-ui` lib (from `crates/ui`) 782 passed, 5 ignored.
- Clippy `-D warnings` on camcraft-motion, camcraft-app and camcraft-ui with all targets: clean.
- Mutation check: I used the authored stadium in `material_source.rs`; `the_pass_extends_by_the_given_distance_at_each_end` fails. I removed the `extend_start` check in `sane.rs`; the command test fails. I passed the authored ends to `slot()`; three tests fail. All mutations are killed.

Requested before merge
- None.

Questions / notes (not blocking)
1. The `sane.rs` check for `extend_end` is not mutation-tested on its own, because the test refuses only a negative start and a NaN end. A negative end value is covered only by the MCP test.
2. No test uses a Selection (picked) source. The PR body says this.
3. The Trochoidal slot has no extension. The decision record names this.
4. The UI change has no screenshot (two number rows). The PR body says this.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
